paragraphs.label: Mở thư và ứng tuyển
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to apply for the position of part-time Community Activities Assistant. I am interested in this opportunity because it would allow me to contribute to a digital learning workshop while developing my skills in a practical working environment.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu tên công việc được tuyển, không chỉ xin tham gia sự kiện.

Ms Brown
parts.labelVi: danh xưng và họ người nhận

parts.text:
,

I am writing to apply for the position of
part-time Community Activities Assistant
. I am interested in this opportunity because it would allow me to contribute to
a digital learning workshop
while developing my skills in a practical working environment.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

I am writing to apply for the position of [vị trí ứng tuyển]. I am interested in this opportunity because it would allow me to contribute to [sự kiện / hoạt động] while developing my skills in a practical working environment.

paragraphs.label: Kinh nghiệm và kỹ năng
paragraphs.text: I have experience in welcoming participants and preparing materials for activities at my college. This has helped me learn to explain simple instructions, organise tasks and respond politely to questions. I believe these skills would be useful when helping participants try a phone-based research task and discuss classroom rules. I am willing to learn and would take care to follow the instructions given by my supervisor.
paragraphs.noteVi: Kinh nghiệm, kỹ năng phải là điều đúng với ứng viên.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application at an interview and provide any further information you may need.
